static_traits.name: Meng Yao
static_traits.social_status: has a friend to confide Work problems in, but has not yet shared the extent of Self-doubt and incompetence
static_traits.medical_history: no history of similar problems; never received psychotherapy;No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, able to describe feelings and automatic thoughts specifically, fairly cooperative; speech rate Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: whenever customers do not like their drinks, I feel I am the worst employee, developing incompetence and self-blame. This feeling has persisted in Work over the past year, recently worsening with more negative feedback, causing me to constantly doubt my abilities and fear Making a mistake at work.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because these feelings of incompetence are affecting my confidence and Work performance; I hope to handle negative feedback better and not let it affect me excessively anymore.

special_situations.event: customers expressing dissatisfaction with drinks or returning drinks
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if customers are not satisfied, it means my ability is insufficient and I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays mistakes, over-examines self, and practices doubly hard to avoid erring again

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback about taste or temperature
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: any negative feedback proves I am utterly worthless at everything
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strives to seek more positive feedback to prove oneself, but is still dominated by negative evaluations

special_situations.event: Making mistakes at work or being criticized by customers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: once I make a mistake, I will be seen as incompetent, and I will never improve
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becomes tense and cautious when interacting with customers to avoid making mistakes again

special_situations.event: interacting with dissatisfied customers and hearing negative comments
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: They definitely think I am terrible; the problem is all on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoidant and cautious when communicating with customers, trying to reduce the risk of being criticized
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: they think I am not capable

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as competent, to receive positive evaluation and acceptance
core_conflict.fear: fear of being criticized and negated, fear of being seen as incompetent after mistakes
defense_goal: reducing the risk of being negated through self-criticism and perfection pursuit
Maintains caution and a degree of avoidance in interactions with customers to stay safe

object_relations.self_representation: an incompetent employee prone to mistakes

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: repeatedly attributing negative feedback entirely to oneself in sessions (e.g. 'It is all my fault')
Shows excessive tension and avoidance when discussing interactions with customers

positive_force: Willing to seek help and cooperate with counseling (actively participates in reality testing)
Has received positive customer feedback and repeat customers
actively trying to improve skill and Work performance
negative_force: excessive Self-denial and labeling ('I am the worst employee')
Mental filtering and overgeneralization, ignoring positive feedback
Afraid of making mistakes and being criticized, leading to tension and avoiding communication
Highly sensitive to others' evaluations, tending toward mind reading and personalization

target_behavior.behavior: intense self-blame and anxiety when customers are dissatisfied, avoiding communication with customers
antecedent: customers expressing dissatisfaction with drinks or returning drinks
Receiving negative feedback about taste or temperature
target_behavior.core_reason: personalizing negative feedback and evaluating self by all-or-nothing standards, forming automatic thoughts like 'I cannot do anything well/I am the worst employee'
target_behavior.function: Avoids negative evaluation and potential criticism, tries to lower the risk of mistakes
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance,Damaged confidence, tense interactions with customers,Anxiety intensified
